findings.title: Security group exposes SSH/RDP to the internet
findings.remediation: Restrict the source to a trusted IP range or use Session Manager instead of open SSH.

findings.title: IAM user with console access has no MFA
findings.remediation: Assign an MFA device or remove console access.

findings.title: No custom IAM password policy set
findings.remediation: Set a password policy with a minimum length of 14.

findings.title: No multi-region CloudTrail trail
findings.remediation: Create a multi-region trail that logs management events.
